DEFENSE: AC 27, touch 17, flat-footed 19 (-1 size, +7 Dex, +1 dodge, +10 natural)
OFFENSE: Special Attacks Blinder, Iron Nail, Maelstrom, Wind Slash
STATISTICS: Str 18, Dex 25, Con 18, Int 12, Wis 15, Cha 19
Feats Dodge, Flyby Attack, Great Fortitude, Improved Natural Attack (Bite), Mobility, Spell Focus (Enfeebling), Weapon Finesse
Skills Bluff +16, Diplomacy +16, Fly +20, Intimidate +19, Perception +17
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, Garuda can peck for his enemy's eyes. If he succeeds in hitting with his bite attack, the target must make a DC 21 Fortitude save or be blinded for 1d4 rounds.

As a standard action, Garuda may assume the form of any Small or Medium creature of the humanoid type, or return to his normal form. If the chosen form has any of the following abilities, he gains the listed ability: darkvision 60 feet, low-light vision, scent, and swim 30 feet. If a Small humanoid is chosen, he gains a +2 size bonus to Dexterity. If a Medium humanoid is chosen, he gains a +2 size bonus to Strength. This is a polymorph ability.

Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, Garuda can deliver a powerful, armor-breaking blow. If he succeeds in hitting with his bite attack, it deals 2d4+4 x 1.5 damage and the target suffers a -6 penalty to AC for 1d4+1 rounds.

Once per day as a full-round action, Garuda can unleash a red, draining wind upon one of his enemies. One enemy within 30 feet must make a Fortitude save (DC 21) or be reduced to a number of hit points equal to their HD. Those who are already at such a level of hit points or lower are reduced to 1 hit point instead. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 33).

3/day as a standard action, Garuda can beat his wings strongly in front of him, sending forth a 60-ft. cone of slashing wind. Those caught in the cone take 15d6 wind damage, with a DC 21 Reflex save for half. Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 31).

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
